fact: The Department of Communications and Digital Technologies issued the final National Policy on Data and Cloud as Notice 2533 of 2024 in Government Gazette 50741 of 31 May 2024, setting government policy on the collection, storage, use and sharing of data across national and provincial government, organs of state and the private sector; the notice carries no printed day, so the date is the gazette date.
system: National Policy on Data and Cloud

fact: National Treasury's reply of 10 September 2024 refers to the 'National Policy on Data and Cloud (2024)' and says Treasury considered its implications and plans to convert its 2016 IFMS licences to cloud-based.
